title: Jazz' Sixth Man Of The Year Jordan Clarkson Totally Violated By Fan [Watch]
htmlContent:
Two seasons ago, the Utah Jazz were in New Orleans taking on the Pelicans. Then, Jordan Clarkson was matched up against Lonzo Ball. During this moment in the game, a fan was trying to ask Clarkson about a haircut photo gone totally wrong.

The fan totally violated the reigning sixth man of the year, but lucky for Clarkson his hair grew back.

Recently, Utah Jazz guard Jordan Clarkson and Black Eyed Peas singer Apl.de.Ap visited Fighting Senator Manny Pacquiao during his training at the Wild Card boxing room.

Manny 'Pacman' Pacquiao had his last fight in July 2019. He defeated boxer Keith Thurman for the WBA Super Welterweight title.

The 42-year-old champion arrived in Los Angeles on July 4 to train for his August 21 fight against Errol Spence Jr. 

Last month, On Saturday (Sunday in Manila), Manny Pacquiao welcomed some celebrity visitors while training at the Wild Card Gym. NBA star Jordan Clarkson and J Rey Soul, and Apl.de.Ap of the Black Eyed Peas, got to watch Manny as he prepared for his upcoming fight.

Clarkson finished his Sixth man of the Year season with 18.4 points. 4.0 rebounds, 2.5 assists in 68 games per game.
